scope: P2 remediation for Today Planner, task execution, blocker workflow, active-project navigation, and Firestore persistence boundaries

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Dependency evaluation used only the primary candidate subset.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Full task-universe scheduling support and regression tests.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Completed dependencies outside the candidate subset were not recognized.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Completed helper dependency outside the primary subset is recognized.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Oversized tasks prevented later fitting tasks from filling capacity.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Oversized recommendations are skipped and covered by regression tests.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Waiting or curing tasks could re-enter primary planning.
Over-capacity Not Today tasks could still show Start.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Today Planner hides Start when the capacity reason is present.
Persistence-boundary tests inspect actual Firestore update payloads.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Blocker validation errors escaped the modal.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Modal-local blockerError handles validation and failed modal writes.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Mobile navigation could retain a stale active-project id.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Active-project changes refresh navigation and helper tests cover alias behavior.

historicalReviewDisposition.finding: Start and resume did not synchronize readiness fields.
historicalReviewDisposition.evidence: Transition updates now include coherent readiness fields.

confidenceLimit: Do not claim more than 95 percent confidence until CI, independent review, and supervisor verification are complete.
